children: Solana is seeing renewed interest from institutional investors as momentum continues to build amid recent price rallies seen across the broad crypto market.
While Solana has continued to pull strong price moves in recent days, its ETF market has also witnessed a substantial resurgence in its trading performance recently.
The rapid institutional interest witnessed by the US spot Solana ETF has seen them record their strongest week in barely a year after they launched.
Latest data shows that the Solana ETFs have collectively attracted a total of $188.21 million in fresh capital between September 21 and September 25, 2026.
Notably, the record weekly inflow came after the Solana ETFs saw $86.67 million in net inflows on Friday, bringing the week's total to a record high.

While this marks the largest weekly inflow ever recorded by the funds since they launched late last year, it signals growing investor interest in Solana as all seven ETFs recorded positive inflows during the week.
Bitwise has maintained leadership in the Solana ETF market since they launched until today, as the firm has continued to attract the largest amount of capital on a daily basis.
While it continues to dominate the market, the Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) attracted about $128.46 million during the five-day period.

title: Solana Sees Biggest ETF Week Since Launch
